notes: Original synthetic text written for this project. Companion to ../retrieval: identifiers, rare terms, names, phrases and near-duplicate passages where exact words matter, plus paraphrase queries where meaning matters. One passage per section.

passage.text: Error ERR-4721 means the payment worker lost its queue connection. Restart the worker and check the broker credentials before retrying the charge.
Error ERR-4712 means the report exporter ran out of disk space. Clear the temporary export folder and rerun the export.
Error ERR-5033 appears when a certificate expires. Renew the certificate and reload the gateway; users see a security warning until then.
Error ERR-4271 is raised when a webhook signature does not match. Check the shared secret on both sides and replay the failed deliveries.
The KX-900 sensor measures soil moisture and reports every ten minutes over a low-power radio link.
The KX-909 sensor measures air temperature and humidity; it needs a firmware update every year.
The ZQ-17 gateway collects readings from field sensors and forwards them to the cloud over cellular data.
Spare batteries for field sensors are stored in the Chattogram depot and shipped within two days.
Employees who work from home must keep a quiet room and a stable internet connection, and tell their manager the hours they are available.
Remote staff are expected to join the weekly planning call; missing two calls in a row needs approval from the team lead.
Expense claims above five thousand taka need a receipt, and the finance office pays approved claims on the first Thursday of the month.
Equipment loans last ninety days; laptops must be returned with the charger and the original bag.
ডক্টর রাহাত খন্দকার ময়মনসিংহে ধানের নতুন জাত নিয়ে গবেষণা করেন এবং প্রতি বছর কৃষকদের প্রশিক্ষণ দেন।
অধ্যাপক ফারহানা চৌধুরী চট্টগ্রাম বন্দরের পরিবেশ দূষণ নিয়ে একটি প্রতিবেদন লিখেছেন।
সুনামগঞ্জের হাওরে বর্ষায় নৌকায় করে স্কুলে যেতে হয়, তাই শিক্ষকরা সকালের ক্লাস দেরিতে শুরু করেন।
রংপুরের তামাক চাষ কমিয়ে কৃষকরা এখন আলু ও ভুট্টা লাগাচ্ছেন, কারণ এতে খরচ কম এবং দাম স্থির।
Deploy করার আগে migration-টা staging-এ চালিয়ে দেখতে হবে, নাহলে rollback করা কঠিন হয়ে যায়।
Redis cache এর TTL কমালে database-এর load বাড়ে, তাই peak hour-এ TTL বাড়িয়ে রাখা ভালো।
JIRA ticket PAY-3318 এ refund bug-টা ঠিক করা হয়েছে; fix-টা release 2.14 এ যাবে।
JIRA ticket PAY-3381 এ invoice PDF-এর font সমস্যা নিয়ে কথা হয়েছে; এটা low priority।
Lighthouses guide ships away from rocky coasts by flashing a light in a fixed pattern at night.
A heron stands motionless in shallow water and strikes quickly when a fish swims close.
Compost turns kitchen scraps into fertiliser after several weeks of regular turning and moisture.
Bridges built from steel cables hang their deck from towers, which lets them cross wide rivers with few supports.
